Moonlight-nx2 native decoder/display subset, from the user-provided archive.
Source: https://gitlab.com/Azkali/moonlight-nx2
The selected original sources, shaders, license and SHA-256 provenance are in
`third_party/moonlight-nx2/`. `tools/build-native-runtime.py` verifies and
bundles that subset as classic JavaScript, without any PC service.
The original LICENSE is also included in app/civapp-notices.js.

The shared renderer and fonts come from CivHomebrew-SDK; their licenses are
in app/vendor/civapps-native-ui-NOTICE.txt and the packaged notices.
